method: Independently inspected each exact original PNG using view_image detail=original before authoring; Pillow measurements supplement those two observations.

fig69.support: One long overhead support, with pairs of converging threads to every ball and common adjacent attachment locations.
fig69.relationships: One almost horizontal nominal-equilibrium chain; every consecutive pair is linked by a coiled light spring; all 18 labels sit below their own balls.
fig69.absent: No waveform, direction arrows, phase labels, axes, scale ticks, second particle row, or numerical dimensions.

fig71.support: Two long rails with a depth connector at each end, forming one perspective support frame; two threads suspend each top-row ball.
fig71.labels: Top apparatus only has numbers 1..18. Source top Cyrillic a and bottom Cyrillic be become English a and b. Bottom balls have no additional number labels.
fig71.referenceMarkMeaning: Each is the nominal equilibrium reference for the corresponding top-row numbered ball, not a bottom suspension or spring.
fig71.bSpacing: Measured pixel gaps contract through balls 4..6, widen around 8..12, contract again around 15..17; order remains 1..18. No displacement curve is drawn.

givenDimension.pixelMethod: Original PNG direct observation; horizontal arrow pixels at rows 404/411 bound the slanted scan.

fig71.absent: No extra springs or suspended supports in panel b, no sine wave, no phase values, no density labels, no answers.
